notes.title: Juniper Theory patch notes – Alpha Patch 1
notes.content:
The Juniper Theory team offers our heartfelt thanks to those players who have provided reports about bugs and issues.  Special thanks go out to Fred Woizeschke and Lavi Bookman Junior, who pointed out bugs so they could get fixed!

Bugfixes

-Fixed logic to allow game to end properly when all AI opponents are defeated in Global Mode
-Fixed conquer nodes not actually having a cost (now properly cost 100 points)
-Fixed conquer node win bug in Battle Mode
-Fixed Canada/Greenland targeting in global mode (Eastern Canada could mistakenly target Iceland rather than Greenland)

Hotfix Update 1/1/2017

Bugfixes

-Fixed conquer node logic to allow AI to conquer player in global mode properly
-Fixed bug that was causing conquer nodes to inadvertently cause nodes to register as neutral as well as player, which was causing some nodes to become defense when build orders were given
